why_ai: AI coding assistants have repriced the category and compressed incumbent roadmaps in three years.
why_clarity: Tools are sold on productivity claims neither buyer nor seller can measure.
why_digital: Code in, software out, bought and supported entirely online.

why_ai: Demand grows with AI, but foundation-model labs can commoditize the product.
why_clarity: Generated code is checkable by tests, though real productivity gains are contested.
why_digital: Code context in, generated code out, fully online software.

why_ai: Platform vendors hold the only corpus of how software is written across millions of repositories.
why_clarity: Corpus signals are structured and stored; which insights matter is still undefined.
why_digital: Repository history in, analytics product out.

why_ai: Near-zero switching costs make any comparable assistant a substitute.
why_clarity: Latency and fit are measurable, and developers judge within days.
why_digital: Installed and used inside editors, bought by developers online.

why_ai: A describable working environment is reproducible by automation and AI agents.
why_clarity: The project either builds on a new machine or it does not.
why_digital: Config and code in, reproducible environments out.

why_ai: AI adoption itself creates demand for provenance, licence and audit controls security will sign off.
why_clarity: Policy checks are definable, but licence exposure judgments remain partly legal.
why_digital: Code and policy data in, governance software out.

why_ai: LLMs read old code well, but changes to estates running banks stay high-stakes.
why_clarity: Static code analysis is mechanical; whether understanding is complete is hard to confirm.
why_digital: Source code in, documentation and analysis out.

why_ai: Language servers are largely derivable from grammars and compilers by AI.
why_clarity: LSP defines the protocol, and features either work or fail.
why_digital: Grammars and compilers in, editor tooling out.

why_ai: Hard systems engineering for the largest accounts, who cannot easily switch.
why_clarity: Index time and search latency are objectively measurable.
why_digital: Repositories in, build and search infrastructure out.

why_ai: Massive AI tooling spend creates demand for credible causal attribution.
why_clarity: No accepted method attributes output changes to a specific tool.
why_digital: Engineering event data in, analytics out.

why_ai: Captured environments let AI reproduce failures that engineers now imagine from prose.
why_clarity: A failure either reproduces or it does not.
why_digital: Bug reports and configs in, reproduced environments out.
